ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area, contrasted by low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edge, tips, and scattered interior spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark border (3-10 pixel width) along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips. Discrete dark circular nodes (5-15 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes. Medial regions of both lobes exhibit low-saturation tan/yellowish mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the lobe peaks of approximately 20% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, displaying varying amplitudes of 2-8 pixels, particularly jagged near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve originating at the distal tips and sweeping toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-contrast dark pixels observed on the distal right lobe (roughly 4-5 units) and isolated nodes on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple thin, dark linear pixel disruptions visible; specifically, a set of horizontal and diagonal scratches in the medial white regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Tan-colored pigmentation patches in the central white regions, potentially indicating biological accumulation or scarring distinct from primary pigmentation.
